limitations: Descriptive selected-ticket cohorts; not randomized or out-of-sample policy comparisons.
All finite groups were inspected; positive subgroups are not promotion evidence.
Financial settlements within young cohorts are incomplete and early losses may resolve before potential winners.
Some fixtures contributed multiple older SINGLE markets; row counts are not all independent.
Three legacy SINGLEs lack frozen probability evidence and are excluded only from probability scoring.
No latest odds feed, historical bookmaker odds feed, new provider call, training or holdout consumption.
COMBO probability/calibration learning is not performed.
